bond_identity.title: Government bond list and daily quotes
bond_identity.summary: Every LKR treasury bond the PDMO publishes a dealer quote for, with each day's average bid and offer yields and prices.

bond_ns_curve.title: LKR government bond yield curve
bond_ns_curve.summary: A Nelson-Siegel curve fitted each day to dealer quotes, and how far each bond's yield sits above or below it.

bond_liquidity.title: Bond trading activity
bond_liquidity.summary: How much each bond has traded over the last 60 days, when it was last auctioned, and its trading-activity tier.

bond_rv_zscores.title: Bond residuals against their own history
bond_rv_zscores.summary: Each bond's distance from the curve, and the spread between neighbouring bonds, compared with their own recent range.

bond_execution_gap.title: Trades against quotes
bond_execution_gap.summary: How far executed trades have printed from the dealers' quoted mid yields over the last 20 days.

bond_carry.title: Carry, rolldown and duration
bond_carry.summary: Each bond's yield over a stated funding rate, its rolldown along an unchanged curve, and both per unit of duration.

cse_market_tape.title: CSE market summary
cse_market_tape.summary: Index levels and changes, turnover against its 20-session average, breadth, and foreign flows for each session.

cse_security_metrics.title: CSE share metrics
cse_security_metrics.summary: For every listed share and session: price change, position in its 52-week range, volume against average, and return relative to the ASPI.
